summary: Windows module debugging must happen on a Windows host: copy the module and the powershell and csharp module_utils folders, comment out #Requires -Module lines with an extra #, and add setup code at the top.
questions: Can I debug a PowerShell module on Linux?
What files do I need to copy to Windows to debug a module?
Why do I need to disable #Requires -Module lines when debugging?

answer_card.title: Prepare to debug a Windows module
answer_card.answer_md:
Debug only on a Windows host:
1. Copy the module script.
2. Copy `lib/ansible/module_utils/powershell` and `.../csharp` next to it.
3. Add an extra `#` before any `#Requires -Module` lines.
4. Add the setup code to the top of the script.
